name: 39470 · Poplarville, MS
findings: ZIP 39470 (Poplarville) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39470 (Poplarville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
